<action type="say">
Here’s how to cancel a reservation on OpenTable for your 7pm tomorrow DC booking for 2.

On the OpenTable app:
1) Open the app and sign in with the same account you used to book.  
2) Go to “Bookings” / “Your Reservations” (sometimes under the profile tab).  
3) Find tomorrow’s 7:00 PM reservation in DC for 2.  
4) Tap the reservation → tap “Cancel Reservation” (or “Modify” → “Cancel”).  
5) Confirm. You should see it marked as canceled and receive an email.

On the OpenTable website:
1) Go to opentable.com and sign in.  
2) Click your profile (top right) → “My Dining History” or “Reservations.”  
3) Under “Upcoming,” find tomorrow’s 7:00 PM reservation.  
4) Click it → choose “Cancel Reservation.”  
5) Confirm and check your email for the cancellation notice.

If you don’t see the reservation:
- Make sure you’re logged into the correct account/email.
- Check both “Upcoming” and any “Past & Upcoming” sections.

If there’s no cancel button or it’s disabled, you’ll need to contact the restaurant directly. If you’d like, tell me the restaurant’s name and I’ll draft a quick script you can use when you call or email them to cancel.</action>
